company.shortDescription: KeepVision offers a mobile application to monitor school children’s vision with the help of a smartphone.
company.description:
KeepVision offers a mobile application to monitor school children’s vision with the help of a smartphone. It measures main visual parameters which include visual acuity and contrast sensitivity.

If any deviations occur, the app recommends the user to visit a relevant eye care professional.
